run_partitioned_data_mapper: run a PartitionedDataMapper subclass to transform batches of input shards into output datasets
create_batch_mapper: create a BatchMapper subclass with a __call__ method that transforms a batch to a batch
use_stopess_data_mapper_decorator: use the stopes_data_mapper decorator to wrap a BatchMapper class into a PartitionedDataMapper
get_class_hierarchy_code: get the source code for each class in a given class hierarchy using get_class_hierarchy_code
configure_partitioned_data_mapper: configure a PartitionedDataMapperConfig with input and output dataset sharding configs for batch processing
